{
  "thinking": "The inspection shows the lower edge of the tail is still disconnected at the tail point and again near the upright. Report it clearly and keep my hands off the tail.",
  "say": "Inspection report on the tail. The body is fine and carries through to the tail point. Two breaks remain. First, at the tail point, the lower edge still turns too sharply into its first bar, so that whole lower edge is pale. Tom, if your bridge didn't take, try a connect from the last bar of the line into the second pale bar rather than the first. Second, near the bottom of the upright, the line turns too sharply, so the corner doesn't feed through. Also, a few bars at the top of the upright, and the little pale curl above the tail point, aren't connected. The curl can stay, since it won't fall. Sofia, the upper edge looks like it's carrying. Tom, shout when the lower edge has gone dark and I'll look again.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 7,
  "point": [23, 11],
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Fish facing left, START near (3,10). Body connected. At 6:00 inspection: breaks at tail point (22.5,11) lower edge pale (~11 bars) and near (27,12) sharp turn at upright bottom; stray pale bars near (23,8) and 3 near (27.5,11). Tom is bridging; Sofia did upper edge. I stay off the tail, re-inspect after Tom reports."
